tytul: Canned cabbage with mushrooms: why not to can it
wstep: There is no recipe for canned cabbage with mushrooms here.

ostrzezenia.tekst: Drying and cooking do not destroy the toxins of poisonous mushrooms, and only an expert can tell edible species from poisonous ones.
Wild mushrooms must not be canned.

akapity: Fresh vegetables, except most tomatoes, are low-acid foods.
Pressure canning is the only recommended method for canning fresh vegetables, and a boiling-water bath means a real risk of botulism for them.
According to Penn State Extension, cabbage is not suitable for pressure canning.
In the NCHFP mixed vegetables recipe, cabbage must not be substituted for any of the vegetables.
A boiling-water bath is suitable only for acid foods, such as sauerkraut.
